name: Grande Bête des Elders
lore: Création originale du jeu, selon le brief partiel ; pas une espèce canonique revendiquée.

assets.label: Grande Bête des Elders — corps, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL alien mount concept for the Yautja fan-game La Longue Chasse. This is a game design, not a canonical franchise creature. Two complete side profiles SIDE BY SIDE, left animal facing RIGHT, right animal facing LEFT. Identical species/body proportions, independent opposite-side details, same scale, pure flat MAGENTA #FF00FF background and wide blank margins. No ground, shadow, scenery, text, labels, panel dividers or rider. Paint a sharp game bitmap with clear anatomy and visible joints. No saddle, harness, cargo, chains or removable armor baked onto the animal; these are separate later modules. A colossal ancient ceremonial quadruped beast with exactly FOUR immense pillar legs and broad clawed feet, imposing high wide shoulder arch, long low powerful saurian head crowned by thick natural curved bony brow crests, deep charcoal pebbled hide and dignified pale age-weathered ivory dorsal ridges. Extremely broad stable back that could bear a future ceremonial howdah, but NO throne or saddle drawn now. Thick short tail and heavy low center of gravity. Timeless calm majesty rather than raging monster. Head neck and joints natural, no ornamental metal or trophies. Four feet distinct.
notes: Identité en revue ; nombre de membres, appuis et détails à contrôler. Selle, cavalier et effets indépendants à produire.
